key.sculksight.activate_sensor: Track th' sensor ye be eyeballin'
sculksight.config.title: Sculk Sight
sculksight.config.shell_opacity.tooltip: How solid th' detection shell looks, arr. Th' see-through pass follows this at a fixed proportion, so one slider moves both.
sculksight.config.render_policy.tooltip: Multi-sensor renderin': draw th' chosen sensors as one merged shape (Joined), or one coloured shell per sensor (Split).
sculksight.config.see_through_inside.too: How strongly th' see-through pass draws while ye be inside th' shell. Full keeps today's look; Weak dims it so th' blocks around ye stay readable; Off skips it, leavin' only th' depth-tested faces ye have line o' sight to.
sculksight.config.global_render.tooltip: Global render: turn all sensor shell renderin' on or off at once, without changin' which sensors be tracked or their individual Aye toggles below. Same as pressin' G.
sculksight.config.delay_overlay.tooltip: Delay overlay: show or hide th' per-block travel-delay numbers over every tracked sensor whose own delay-overlay checkbox (in its Options screen) be on. Same as pressin' H. Has no effect 'til at least one such sensor be rendered.
sculksight.config.detection_indicator.to: Detection indicator: report in chat whenever ye enter or leave a tracked sensor's detection range. Independent o' th' shell above. Same as pressin' J.
sculksight.config.tracked_sensors.name: %s (%s, %s, %s)
sculksight.config.tracked_sensors.enable: Toggle whether this sensor's shell be rendered.
sculksight.config.tracked_sensors.remove: Casts this sensor off th' tracked-render list immediately.
sculksight.config.tracked_sensors.delete: Casts off every tracked sensor from th' list immediately. Doesn't affect a live find in progress.
sculksight.config.tracked_sensors.option: Opens this sensor's name, aye/nay, and delay-overlay controls, arr.
sculksight.config.tracked_sensors.rename: Applies this name to th' sensor.
sculksight.config.tracked_sensors.delay_: Shows this sensor's per-block delay numbers whenever th' delay overlay (H) be on.
sculksight.config.audit_sensors.empty: No sensors in range from where ye be standin'.
sculksight.config.audit_sensors.shown.to: Shows or hides this found sensor's shell. A live find saves nothin', so this lasts 'til ye pin it, run another find, run '/sculksight find off', or leave th' world.
sculksight.config.audit_sensors.pin.tool: Adds every sensor this live find chose to th' tracked sensors above, where they be saved and keep their own Options and Cast Off controls. This ends th' live find, so th' shells stop followin' ye. Same result as runnin' th' find with 'static'.
sculksight.command.find.live: Live find: %s. Th' shells follow ye 'til ye leave th' world or run another find.
sculksight.command.find.selection.none: No sensors found in range, arr.
sculksight.command.find.cap_reached: Cap reached: %s sensors matched, showin' th' nearest %s.
sculksight.command.find.detector.unknown: Unknown detector type '%s'. Expected one o' %s.
sculksight.command.find.radius.out_of_ra: Radius %s be out o' range. Expected %s to %s blocks.
sculksight.command.find.usage: Radius and mode be required for a find, e.g. /sculksight find <type> <radius> <static|live>. Use /sculksight find off with nothin' else to cancel a live find.
sculksight.command.pin.added.one: 1 sensor added to tracked sensors, arr.
sculksight.command.pin.added.many: %s sensors added to tracked sensors, matey.
sculksight.command.pin.rejected_cap: ; %s didn't fit th' tracked limit o' %s
sculksight.chat.detection.entered: ye be within a sensor's detection range now.
sculksight.chat.detection.left: ye be no longer within any sensor's detection range.
sculksight.chat.activate.no_listener: th' targeted block at %s has no game event listener.
sculksight.chat.activate.not_detector: th' targeted block at %s be not a detector.
sculksight.chat.activate.limit_reached: th' tracked sensor limit be %s, so th' sensor at %s wasn't tracked.
sculksight.chat.activate.already_tracked: sensor at %s be already tracked, arr.
sculksight.chat.activate.tracked: sensor at %s be tracked now, matey.
